widgets_values:
[TOP-LEFT]
A medium shot taken from a slightly left-frontal angle. The person tilts their head slightly, with the center of gravity shifting to one side. Their eyes are focused and carry a hint of playfulness as they stare directly at the camera. The corners of their mouth curl up gently, as if holding back a laugh. The hair falls naturally over the shoulders, and the background is blurred to highlight the subject.
[TOP-RIGHT]
A close shot taken from a low angle in the front. The person lowers their head slightly and tucks their chin in. With long eyelashes, their bright and expressive eyes are fixed on the camera, revealing a shy and gentle expression. Their cheeks are slightly flushed, and some strands of hair fall down, covering part of the forehead, creating a subtle and charming look.
[BOTTOM-LEFT]
An eye close-up shot taken from a 45-degree angle directly above, focusing on the person's eyes. The eyes are intently fixed on the camera, bright and shining. There seems to be a different story in the pupils. The outer corners of the eyes are slightly lifted, and there is a smile at the corners of the eyes. The skin around the eyelids is delicate, and the eyelashes are distinct, showing a look full of vitality and curiosity in the eyes.
[BOTTOM-RIGHT]
A close shot taken from a slightly high angle on the right side. The person raises their face slightly and turns their head gently to the right. Their mouth is slightly open, revealing white teeth, and there is a big smile at the corners of their mouth. Their eyes are firm and full of confidence as they look directly at the camera, and the hair flutters gently with the movement, making the whole picture full of energy.

The image is a photograph of a young woman with long dark hair, fair skin, and red lipstick. She wears a grey hoodie with black text and a black necklace. The background is plain white. The woman has a serious expression. The image is cropped above her waist and below her shoulders.<|end_of_text|>
